checklist: rsync -a --itemize-changes on a fresh tree: upstream's lines and order (cd+++++++++ / >f+++++++++)
-a keeps file modes, file and directory mtimes and contents (find/stat/md5sum snapshot equal)
no change → 'Number of regular files transferred: 0'; one changed file → 1, itemized >f.st...... and only that file
--delete removes extra files and dirs; -n/--dry-run lists 'deleting …' and '(DRY RUN)' and changes nothing
--exclude='*.log' --exclude=logs/ skips them, and --delete keeps excluded files in the destination
-c: same size and mtime, other bytes → skipped by the quick check, sent with -c (>fc........)

symlinks (relative, absolute into the source, to a dir, dangling) with their own mtimes (touch -h): all 8 option sets (-a, -a -J, -a --omit-link-times, -a --times, -a --no-omit-link-times, -a --no-J, -a -t --no-J, -a -J --no-omit-link-times) copy with rc 0, links recreated (cL+++++++++, readlink equal), link mtimes preserved unless -J wins, source untouched, re-run quiet (slicc-kernel#170 fixed in 1.29.2)
missing source dir or file: rc 23 with change_dir / link_stat messages

SIGINT, SIGTERM and SIGHUP mid-transfer (timeout -s <sig> on a --bwlimit copy of a 4 MB file, 3.5.1-1): rc 20 'received SIGINT, SIGTERM, or SIGHUP (code 20)' within 10 s, no rsync left in ps, and the temp file removed (bigout/ empty); with --partial (INT) and --inplace (TERM) bigout/z is kept, shorter than the source

daemon (3.4.4-3, netfork): rsync --daemon --no-detach on a kernel port; rsync://127.0.0.1:8730/ lists 'mod', -a push and pull (via localhost) round-trip the files, a closed port gives 'Connection refused' rc 10, the daemon log shows the access; 3.5.1-3 (homescoop#176, the socket shim's getnameinfo): the daemon names the loopback client localhost, the log says 'connect from localhost (127.0.0.1)' with no 'name lookup failed' or UNKNOWN, a module with 'hosts allow = localhost' + 'hosts deny = *' lets 127.0.0.1 pull (rc 0), and one with 'hosts deny = localhost' refuses it ('@ERROR: access denied to nolh from localhost (127.0.0.1)', rc 5). 3.5.1-2: UNKNOWN, the named allow refuses (rc 5) and the named deny lets it in (NEGATIVE.md)
tailnet (uplink): rsync://peer.tail1234.ts.net/ resolves via the kernel resolver/uplink and dials 100.64.1.2:873 (refused → 'Connection refused' rc 10); an unknown tailnet name → rc 10 without a dial

users (users enforce, 3.4.4-4): rsync links the slicc credentials, so root is root: root rsync -a of cone's tree keeps 1000:1000 and the modes (640, 4755, dirs 755); cone's rsync -a of root's 0:100 file gives 1000:100 (its own uid, a group it is in). 3.4.4-3: root's copy gives 0:1000 (owner not kept) and cone's 1000:1000 (NEGATIVE.md)

slicc-kernel 1.73.3 (#467: slicc-kernel#449 and the directory-mtime fix): cone's rsync -a of a tree with a symlink, a dangling one and one to a directory exits 0 with the links cone:cone (on 1.73.2 and older: rc 23, 'chgrp … failed: Operation not permitted', since a just-created symlink's own lstat said 0:0); the checklist's re-runs are quiet again, the destination's top directory keeping the source's mtime (failing on 1.36.0-1.73.2); slicc-kernel 1.75.1 (#477): a write after touch -d updates the mtime in the browser entry, which the incremental re-run needs (1.73.3's browser kept the touched time)

cert/symlink-dest.mjs (3.5.1, homescoop#411; upstream's 3.5.0 secure resolver), users enforce: eve's symlink /tmp/evelink → evereal (in sticky /tmp) as cone's destination is refused, rc 3, 'refusing to follow a symlink owned by an untrusted user' naming --insecure-links, nothing copied; rsync -a --insecure-links copies through it (cone owns the copy); as root, -K into a destination dirlink with an absolute target gives rc 23 'Symbolic link loop' and writes nothing through it, while -K into an in-tree relative dirlink gives rc 0 with the file in the link's target; the link's owner counts, not the caller (homescoop#555): cone's own link and a root-owned link are followed (rc 0), root is refused through eve's link (rc 3, nothing copied), and -K into a ../out dirlink gives rc 23 with nothing in out/. 3.4.4-5 follows both (rc 0, NEGATIVE.md); the README's 'Symlinks in the destination (3.5.x)' says the same
